activities.badge: UNIT 1: WHAT IS AN AI CHATBOT?
activities.title: Meet AI Chatbots
activities.subtitle: Today we’ll learn about AI chatbots.
activities.body:
A chatbot is an AI helper that talks with people using words. Chatbots can answer questions, suggest ideas, and help you inside apps or websites.

You may have seen chatbots in games, shopping, search, and support.

activities.title: Do you know these AI apps?
activities.subtitle: Tap the AI companies or AI-powered apps.
activities.body: Choose every example that uses modern AI.

activities.title: Place the right words
activities.subtitle: Complete the explanation using the word bank.
activities.body: An LLM is a type of artificial intelligence designed to understand and generate _____. It reads massive amounts of _____ and can _____.

activities.title: Ask the chatbot a question
activities.subtitle: Choose a question and watch how the bot replies.
activities.body: Hi! I’m BearFetch Bot. Ask me a question, and I’ll reply with an answer.

activities.title: Word Puzzle Blocks
activities.subtitle: Put the word pieces in the correct order.
activities.body: Words can be split into smaller parts called tokens. Build the sentence below.

activities.title: Guess the Next Word
activities.subtitle: What is the most likely next word?

activities.title: Which reply remembers?
activities.subtitle: Memory helps a chatbot use earlier messages.
activities.body:
User: My favorite planet is Mars.
Bot: Got it. Your favorite planet is Mars.
User: Tell me more about my favorite planet.
options: Mars is called the Red Planet. It has dusty red soil, tall volcanoes, and two small moons.
Which planet do you mean? Please tell me the planet name first.

activities.title: Talk to AI Properly
activities.subtitle: See how changing the prompt changes the answer.
activities.body:
Better prompt: “Tell me 3 fun facts about Mars for kids in short sentences.”

The answer gives clear, short, kid-friendly facts.
options: It asked for a kid-friendly answer

activities.title: Make AI Funny or Serious
activities.subtitle: Choose a style and see how the answer changes.
activities.body:
Prompt: “Explain what a black hole is.”

A black hole is like a cosmic vacuum cleaner with a huge appetite. Even light cannot escape its pull.

activities.title: Chatbot Roles
activities.subtitle: How should an LLM respond to a person’s prompt?
activities.body: A chatbot should guide conversations, provide useful information, and help people complete tasks.

activities.title: What is a Chatbot Made Of?
activities.subtitle: Place the parts in the correct order.
activities.body: A chatbot needs a screen, a brain, knowledge, and a reply.

activities.title: Choose the best chatbot UI
activities.subtitle: A good chatbot screen shows messages clearly and gives users a simple place to type.
activities.body: Compare the two layouts and choose the one designed for conversations.
options: BearFetch Chat — clear messages and a reply field

activities.title: Send a Message
activities.subtitle: Who’s doing what?
activities.body:
User asks: “What is 5 × 5?”
The chatbot is generating…
The answer is 25!

activities.title: First Working Bot
activities.subtitle: Does this look like a normal output?
activities.body:
User: Who are you?

BearFetch Bot: Hi, I am an AI chatbot. I can answer questions, explain ideas, and help you learn.

activities.title: Choose Chatbot Type
activities.subtitle: What should your chatbot focus on?
activities.body: Pick the kind of chatbot you want to build.

activities.title: Choose Training Examples
activities.subtitle: Pick the data that matches your chatbot’s purpose.
activities.body: Your chatbot: Study Coach Bot. It should help with study tips, reminders, and learning guidance.

activities.title: Test Your Bot
activities.subtitle: Did your chatbot answer well?
activities.body:
Prompt: “How can I study for a science test?”

Response: Start with the hardest topics. Review one at a time, make short notes, and take a quick break after 20 minutes.
